settlement_rules_verified_for_both.rule: Market resolves YES if winning candidate is affiliated with specified party, NO otherwise. A candidate running on a fusion ticket counts for every party on that ticket, so multiple party markets may resolve YES for the same race.

settlement_rules_verified_for_both.settlement_field_warning: Info shows a Settlement YES field even while Active; do not treat this as an already resolved outcome.
